sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将对部分采访进行直播，供所有人免费观看，网址是nytimes.com。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: When the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当美国

sentences.en: completes its campaign to immunize every eligible American against COVID-19, about a quarter of the population will remain unvaccinated.
sentences.zh: 完成为所有符合条件的美国人接种新冠疫苗的行动时，仍将有约四分之一的人口未接种疫苗。

sentences.en: My colleague, science reporter
sentences.zh: 我的同事，科学记者

sentences.en: Apoorva Mondavili, on what exactly happens to kids.
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦·曼达维利，将带我们了解孩子们到底会怎样。

sentences.en: It's Friday, February 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月19日，星期五。

sentences.en: Apoorva, if you are an adult in the United States, you are starting to see the end of the pandemic on the horizon for yourself.
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦，如果你是美国的成年人，你已经开始看到疫情结束的曙光了。

sentences.en: A clear timeline has emerged.
sentences.zh: 一个明确的时间表已经出现。

sentences.en: The summer of 2021, you're probably going to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 2021年夏天，你很可能会接种疫苗。

sentences.en: But if you are a parent, I feel like there are some burning questions that complicate that timeline about your kids.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是家长，我觉得关于孩子的问题会让这个时间表变得复杂，这些问题让你如坐针毡。

sentences.en: And so that's what we want to talk with you about today.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们今天想和你讨论的内容。

sentences.en: You know, we've all been really excited that we have these vaccines.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们都对拥有这些疫苗感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And the focus has been so much on who gets sick and getting to them firSt. And of course, that's been older people, frontline
sentences.zh: 大家的注意力都集中在谁会生病以及优先为谁接种上。当然，那主要是老年人、一线

sentences.en: workers, that we've sort of forgotten to talk openly about the fact that kids need to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 工作人员，以至于我们几乎忘了公开讨论孩子也需要接种疫苗这一事实。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think even I, as a parent, didn't spend that much time thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 我想即使是我，作为一名家长，也没有花太多时间去考虑这个问题。

sentences.en: But kids make up about 24% of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但儿童约占美国

sentences.en: population.
sentences.zh: 人口的24%。

sentences.en: Almost one in four.
sentences.zh: 几乎四分之一。

sentences.en: So even if almost every adult gets vaccinated, that's still a huge percent of the population that will not have any protection.
sentences.zh: 所以即使几乎所有成年人都接种了疫苗，仍有很大一部分人口没有任何保护。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A quarter of the American population will be not vaccinated at the point at which we all kind of regard vaccinations as having been completed.
sentences.zh: 在我们普遍认为疫苗接种工作已经完成的时候，四分之一的美国人口将没有接种疫苗。

sentences.en: But remind us why kids are not being vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 但请提醒我们，为什么孩子们没有接种疫苗？

sentences.en: Kids are not being vaccinated because we haven't tested these vaccines in kids.
sentences.zh: 孩子们没有接种疫苗，是因为我们还没有在儿童身上测试过这些疫苗。

sentences.en: We don't know that they are safe or that they are effective in kids.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道它们对儿童是否安全或有效。

sentences.en: We've mainly tested these vaccines in adults, and we know it works in them.
sentences.zh: 我们主要是在成年人身上测试了这些疫苗，并且知道它们对成年人有效。

sentences.en: And there's a pretty good likelihood that they'll work in kids, but we can't be sure until we've actually done the trials.
sentences.zh: 它们在儿童身上很可能也有效，但在我们真正完成试验之前，我们无法确定。

sentences.en: And the reason we haven't done those trials yet is because kids just don't get sick at nearly the same rates as adults do.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以还没有进行这些试验，是因为儿童感染新冠的几率远低于成年人。

sentences.en: For the most part, COVID is very mild in kids.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，儿童感染新冠后的症状非常轻微。

sentences.en: Most kids don't even have any symptoMs. And so it's just not been a priority to get them vaccinated as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 大多数孩子甚至没有任何症状。因此，尽快为他们接种疫苗一直不是优先事项。

sentences.en: And when you say that kids don't get sick at the same rate as adults, I wonder if you can quantify that.
sentences.zh: 当你提到儿童感染新冠的几率不如成年人时，我想知道你是否能量化这一点。

sentences.en: Because my sense from previous conversations we've had with our colleagues on the show is that kids can get sick from COVID.
sentences.zh: 因为根据我们之前与节目中同事的交谈，我的感觉是儿童也会感染新冠。

sentences.en: In fact, they can get quite sick.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们可能会病得很重。

sentences.en: And they do transmit the virus, but they don't transmit it with quite the same efficiency as adults.
sentences.zh: 他们确实会传播病毒，但传播效率不如成年人那么高。

sentences.en: Yeah, you are right.
sentences.zh: 是的，你说得对。

sentences.en: But we should probably first say what we mean by kids.
sentences.zh: 但我们首先应该明确我们所说的“孩子”是指什么。

sentences.en: Because the risk for kids is very different based on whether you're talking about a nine-year-old versus a 17-year-old.
sentences.zh: 因为九岁孩子和十七岁孩子的风险是非常不同的。

sentences.en: We think that kids under 10 are not very likely to be infected and not very likely to get sick.
sentences.zh: 我们认为10岁以下的儿童不太可能被感染，也不太可能生病。

sentences.en: But as you get closer to the older teens, it starts to look more and more like adulthood.
sentences.zh: 但随着年龄增长接近青少年后期，情况就越来越像成年人了。

sentences.en: But let's talk about younger kids.
sentences.zh: 但我们先谈谈年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: It's true that most kids don't really have any symptoMs. They don't get very sick.
sentences.zh: 确实，大多数孩子真的没有任何症状。他们不会病得很重。

sentences.en: But that some do develop this very severe condition, immune condition, and some kids do die.
sentences.zh: 但有些孩子确实会发展成这种非常严重的免疫疾病，也有一些孩子因此死亡。

sentences.en: We've had overall about 250 deaths in kids.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我们大约有250名儿童死亡病例。

sentences.en: But compare that to the 500,000 in adults.
sentences.zh: 但与成年人的50万死亡病例相比，

sentences.en: And it's a very, very small slice.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个非常、非常小的比例。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so that kind of crude math is a big reason why we have decided to vaccinate adults first, not children.
sentences.zh: 所以这种粗略的计算是我们决定先为成年人而不是儿童接种疫苗的一个重要原因。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's a very practical reason too.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个非常现实的原因。

sentences.en: Because when we think about how we cope with this pandemic, one of the huge issues is the load on hospitals.
sentences.zh: 因为当我们思考如何应对这场大流行时，一个巨大的问题是医院的负荷。

sentences.en: If we want to make sure that hospitals are not overloaded, if we want to make sure that people aren't dying just because the doctors can't get to them all, we have to make
sentences.zh: 如果我们想确保医院不会超负荷，如果我们想确保人们不会仅仅因为医生无法照顾到所有人而死亡，我们就必须

sentences.en: sure that we get to the people who get the sickeSt. And that's just not kids.
sentences.zh: 确保我们先救治病情最重的人。而那并不是孩子。

sentences.en: And what about transmission by kids?
sentences.zh: 那么儿童的传播情况呢？

sentences.en: What's our latest understanding of that phenomenon?
sentences.zh: 我们对这一现象的最新了解是什么？

sentences.en: This is one of those topics that has changed a lot over the course of the year.
sentences.zh: 这是今年发生很大变化的话题之一。

sentences.en: We started out not really knowing whether kids transmit the virus.
sentences.zh: 起初我们并不真正知道儿童是否会传播病毒。

sentences.en: It was very clear that they don't get sick at the same rates, but we didn't know about the spread.
sentences.zh: 很明显他们感染的几率不同，但我们不知道传播的情况。

sentences.en: What we think now is that most likely kids under 10, so elementary school age kids,
sentences.zh: 我们现在的看法是，10岁以下的儿童，也就是小学年龄段的孩子，

sentences.en: transmit the virus about half as efficiently as adults do, or maybe even less.
sentences.zh: 传播病毒的效率大约是成年人的一半，甚至更低。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But that's a little bit different as you start to move towards middle school or high school age.
sentences.zh: 但当你开始进入初中或高中年龄段时，情况就有点不同了。

sentences.en: So older teens, around 15, something happens.
sentences.zh: 所以对于15岁左右的青少年，会发生一些变化。

sentences.en: There's a switch of some sort.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上出现了一个转折点。

sentences.en: And now kids are more likely to transmit and they start to behave pretty much like adults.
sentences.zh: 现在孩子们更有可能传播病毒，他们的行为开始变得和成年人差不多了。

sentences.en: We don't know if some of that is because teenagers just like to hang out with each other.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这是否部分是因为青少年喜欢聚在一起。

sentences.en: Some of that could just be how they socialize.
sentences.zh: 这可能仅仅是他们的社交方式。

sentences.en: But it definitely looks like the advantage that we have with low transmission is really only for young kids.
sentences.zh: 但看起来我们在低传播率方面的优势确实只存在于年幼的孩子身上。

sentences.en: And do we yet understand why young kids are not great at transmitting the virus?
sentences.zh: 我们是否已经了解为什么年幼的孩子传播病毒的能力不强？

sentences.en: There are a lot of theories, but no, we do not know.
sentences.zh: 有很多理论，但不，我们不知道。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the essential thing to know about kids, especially younger kids and the coronavirus is that they are not great spreaders, but they are still spreaders of the virus.
sentences.zh: 所以关于孩子，尤其是年幼的孩子和冠状病毒，最重要的一点是：他们不是超级传播者，但他们仍然会传播病毒。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: So given that, how big a deal is it that children are not in line for vaccinations at this moment and
sentences.zh: 那么鉴于此，目前儿童不在疫苗接种队列中，以及

sentences.en: that 25 percent of our population, nearly, will be unvaccinated at the end of this vaccination process that's now underway in the United States?
sentences.zh: 在美国目前正在进行的疫苗接种过程中，近25%的人口最终将无法接种疫苗，这有多严重？

sentences.en: On a very temporary basis, it's not a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 在短期内，这并不是什么大问题。

sentences.en: But long term, as in by the end of the year or early next year, we do need to have kids vaccinated because I'm sure you've heard Dr. Fauci and
sentences.zh: 但从长远来看，比如到今年年底或明年年初，我们确实需要让孩子们接种疫苗，因为我相信你已经听过福奇博士和

sentences.en: everybody else say we need to get to something like 80 percent of the population vaccinated in order to reach heart immunity.
sentences.zh: 其他所有人说过，我们需要让大约80%的人口接种疫苗才能达到群体免疫。

sentences.en: That's that point at which the virus basically runs out of people to infect.
sentences.zh: 那就是病毒基本上找不到人来感染的临界点。

sentences.en: But we are not going to get to that 80 percent without kids.
sentences.zh: 但没有孩子，我们无法达到那80%。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: As you noted, kids make up
sentences.zh: 正如你所指出的，孩子占

sentences.en: 25 percent of the population.
sentences.zh: 人口的25%。

sentences.en: So even if every single adult were to get vaccinated, which is looking very unlikely, we will not stop the virus completely until we have stopped it circulating.
sentences.zh: 所以即使每个成年人都接种了疫苗——这看起来不太可能——除非我们阻止病毒传播，否则我们无法完全阻止它。

sentences.en: And until we stop kids from spreading it, too, we just won't reach heart immunity.
sentences.zh: 而且除非我们也阻止孩子传播病毒，否则我们根本无法达到群体免疫。

sentences.en: Mm hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I feel like nobody quite explained that to all of us when we started talking about
sentences.zh: 我觉得当我们开始讨论

sentences.en: the idea that the country was going to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 全国都要接种疫苗这个想法时，没有人向我们解释清楚这一点。

sentences.en: Am I wrong?
sentences.zh: 我错了吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's fair.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很公平。

sentences.en: That's fair to say.
sentences.zh: 这样说很公平。

sentences.en: I think it's mainly because so much of the focus was on hospitalization and death.
sentences.zh: 我认为这主要是因为大部分注意力都集中在住院和死亡上。

sentences.en: So we really weren't thinking about kids as much.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实没有过多考虑孩子。

sentences.en: The goal was just to get to these older people and the high risk people, get them vaccinated as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 目标只是尽快让老年人和高危人群接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Because kids weren't getting sick, we just weren't thinking about them quite as much.
sentences.zh: 因为孩子们没有生病，我们只是没有过多考虑他们。

sentences.en: And so we didn't make it clear that when we talk about herd immunity, we have to take the kids into account.
sentences.zh: 所以我们没有明确说明，当我们谈论群体免疫时，必须把孩子考虑在内。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So knowing now how important it will be to get children vaccinated in order to achieve herd
sentences.zh: 那么现在知道为了实现群体

sentences.en: immunity, what exactly is the plan for getting most children in the United States vaccinated?
sentences.zh: 免疫，让儿童接种疫苗有多重要，美国让大多数儿童接种疫苗的计划究竟是什么？

sentences.en: What is the plan and what is the timeline?
sentences.zh: 计划是什么，时间表又是什么？

sentences.en: So there is a plan and it's already in motion.
sentences.zh: 确实有一个计划，而且已经在实施中了。

sentences.en: Pfizer and Moderna both have clinical trials for their vaccines in kids 12 and older.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞和莫德纳都在为12岁及以上的儿童进行疫苗临床试验。

sentences.en: And we will have answers from those trials probably by the summer.
sentences.zh: 我们可能在夏天就能得到这些试验的结果。

sentences.en: And once we know how the vaccines work in those kids, we'll also start to test them in kids younger than that.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们知道疫苗在这些孩子身上如何起作用，我们也会开始在更小的孩子身上进行测试。

sentences.en: But we won't know the results for that until probably the fall, which means we won't actually have the vaccines in hand and get them into kids until the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 但我们可能要到秋天才能知道结果，这意味着我们实际上要到年底才能拿到疫苗并给孩子们接种。

sentences.en: So we're talking about five or six or so months after all adults who are eligible get vaccinated before children will really get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 所以我们说的是在所有符合条件的成年人接种疫苗后的五六个月左右，孩子们才能真正接种疫苗。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's if everything goes well.
sentences.zh: 而且那还是在一切顺利的情况下。

sentences.en: If we have hit a few snags, there are a few production probleMs. It probably can go on till early next year sometime.
sentences.zh: 如果我们遇到一些障碍，比如生产问题，这可能会持续到明年年初的某个时候。

sentences.en: But then the question becomes, if these vaccines are approved for children, will parents let their kids get the vaccines?
sentences.zh: 但接下来的问题是，如果这些疫苗被批准用于儿童，家长们会让他们接种吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a very, very big question because as we've been saying, kids don't get very sick.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常、非常大的问题，因为正如我们所说，孩子们不会病得很重。

sentences.en: So what is the incentive for a parent to opt for the vaccine?
sentences.zh: 那么家长选择接种疫苗的动力是什么呢？

sentences.en: I can see a lot of parents saying, my kid's not going to get very sick.
sentences.zh: 我能预见到很多家长会说，我的孩子又不会病得很重。

sentences.en: Why should I even take the chance of side effects with a vaccine if COVID is actually less of a problem?
sentences.zh: 如果新冠实际上没那么严重，我为什么要冒着疫苗副作用的风险呢？

sentences.en: The answer to that, of course, is that kids do keep transmitting the virus.
sentences.zh: 当然，答案是孩子们确实会持续传播病毒。

sentences.en: And if you want to see the end of this pandemic, we do have to have the kids vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 如果你想看到这场大流行结束，我们确实必须让孩子们接种疫苗。

sentences.en: But at an individual level, knowing how hard it is to get all parents to vaccinate, even for things like measles, this may be a challenge.
sentences.zh: 但在个人层面，考虑到让所有家长接种疫苗有多难，即使是像麻疹这样的疾病，这可能也是一个挑战。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Apoorva, it feels like what you just described is a form of parental vaccine hesitancy.
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦，感觉你刚才描述的是一种家长对疫苗的犹豫心理。

sentences.en: I don't know if it's called that, but it sounds like you anticipate and the people you talk to in public health anticipate that this is going to be a problem given the unique
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否叫这个名字，但听起来你和你在公共卫生领域交谈的人都预料到，鉴于我们面临的独特情况——即儿童不会病得很重，

sentences.en: situation we face where children don't get very sick.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个问题。

sentences.en: They're not even that great at transmitting it.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至传播病毒的能力都不强。

sentences.en: And the side effects from these vaccines could be meaningful.
sentences.zh: 而且这些疫苗的副作用可能是显著的。

sentences.en: So I think what this does is it puts the onus on the companies to show that these vaccines are so safe and so free of side effects that it's really not a big deal to get them.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这把责任推给了制药公司，要求他们证明这些疫苗非常安全且没有副作用，以至于接种它们真的没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: And by all accounts, is that what the clinical trials are showing so far?
sentences.zh: 从各方面来看，目前的临床试验显示出这一点了吗？

sentences.en: The trials have barely begun, so we don't know.
sentences.zh: 试验才刚刚开始，所以我们不知道。

sentences.en: We're just going to have to wait and see.
sentences.zh: 我们只能拭目以待。

sentences.en: I'm going to boldly ask you.
sentences.zh: 我要大胆地问你一下。

sentences.en: You're a parent.
sentences.zh: 你是一位家长。

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 我是。

sentences.en: You're going to vaccinate your children?
sentences.zh: 你会给你的孩子接种疫苗吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然会。

sentences.en: I believe in science.
sentences.zh: 我相信科学。

sentences.en: I'm a science journaliSt. So yeah, I'm skeptical of companies, lots of things that companies do.
sentences.zh: 我是一名科学记者。所以，是的，我对各大公司以及它们所做的许多事情持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: I ask tough questions about what they do, and I ask tough questions of the government.
sentences.zh: 我会对它们的行为提出尖锐的问题，也会对政府提出尖锐的问题。

sentences.en: But on these vaccines, I have no doubt that they are safe, they are effective, and they are what we need to get out of this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但对于这些疫苗，我毫不怀疑它们是安全有效的，也是我们走出这场疫情所必需的。

sentences.en: So yes, the second those vaccines are available for my kids, I'm going to take them.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，一旦这些疫苗可以供我的孩子们接种，我就会带他们去接种。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So knowing that this hesitancy is real, and then a meaningful gap period will exist between when parents and adults are vaccinated, let's talk about the world that's going to exist
sentences.zh: 既然这种犹豫心理是真实存在的，而且在父母和成年人接种疫苗与孩子接种疫苗之间会存在一段明显的间隔期，那我们来谈谈即将到来的世界吧，

sentences.en: when adults do have vaccinations and their kids don't.
sentences.zh: 也就是成年人已经接种了疫苗，而他们的孩子还没有接种的时候。

sentences.en: And I wonder if we should start with schools.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该从学校开始谈起。

sentences.en: What will it mean for the reopening of schools?
sentences.zh: 这对学校重新开放意味着什么？

sentences.en: Schools should really open this fall, whether kids are vaccinated or not, because we already know that kids are not the ones who are at highest risk in these schools.
sentences.zh: 学校确实应该在今年秋季开放，无论孩子们是否接种了疫苗，因为我们已经知道，在这些学校里，风险最高的并不是孩子们。

sentences.en: The risk is to the adults, and teachers will have had their vaccines, the staff will have had their vaccines, and hopefully
sentences.zh: 风险在于成年人，而教师们届时已经接种了疫苗，教职员工也已经接种了疫苗，希望

sentences.en: all the people who are vulnerable in their homes will have had vaccines.
sentences.zh: 所有家中易感的人群也都已经接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: And the CDC said last week that even vaccinating teachers is a priority, but it shouldn't be a prerequisite.
sentences.zh: 美国疾控中心上周表示，尽管为教师接种疫苗是优先事项，但这不应成为复课的前提条件。

sentences.en: So we should really be thinking planning to reopen schools by the fall, if not sooner.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实应该考虑并规划在秋季，甚至更早的时候重新开放学校。

sentences.en: But can teachers still theoretically come into contact with kids who have the virus and become carriers themselves?
sentences.zh: 但从理论上讲，教师们是否仍有可能接触到携带病毒的孩子，并自己成为病毒携带者？

sentences.en: Because there's no evidence that vaccines prevent you from carrying the virus.
sentences.zh: 因为目前没有证据表明疫苗能防止你携带病毒。

sentences.en: There's very much that possibility.
sentences.zh: 这种可能性非常大。

sentences.en: So I'm going to say something that is going to be very unpopular.
sentences.zh: 所以我要说一些非常不受欢迎的话。

sentences.en: Everyone is still going to need to wear masks for quite a while longer.
sentences.zh: 每个人在相当长的一段时间内仍然需要佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: So teachers will need to wear masks in school.
sentences.zh: 因此，教师在学校里也需要佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: They can be a little bit less worried about getting sick or dying, but they cannot be confident that they won't give it to somebody else.
sentences.zh: 他们可以少担心一点生病或死亡的问题，但他们不能确信自己不会把病毒传染给别人。

sentences.en: So they should really be wearing masks, and so should the kids.
sentences.zh: 所以他们确实应该佩戴口罩，孩子们也一样。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So masks will continue to be a major part of our lives, in part because we're dealing with this gap between adults and children and vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 所以口罩将继续成为我们生活的重要组成部分，部分原因是我们正在应对成年人和儿童在疫苗接种时间上的差距。

sentences.en: It's in part because of the gap, but let's also remember that not every adult is going to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 这部分是因为这个差距，但我们也别忘了，并非每个成年人都会接种疫苗。

sentences.en: There will be people who don't want to get the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 会有一些人不想接种疫苗。

sentences.en: There will be some people who can't get the vaccine for whatever reason.
sentences.zh: 也会有一些人因为各种原因无法接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So there will be other people who are susceptible and whom we need to protect.
sentences.zh: 所以还会有其他人处于易感状态，我们需要保护他们。

sentences.en: So we will need to wear masks until we're at heart immunity, and then we might be able to stop wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 因此，在达到群体免疫之前，我们都需要佩戴口罩，之后我们或许才能停止佩戴。

sentences.en: I want to present you another scenario.
sentences.zh: 我想为你提出另一个场景。

sentences.en: A vaccinated adult wants to start traveling again, wants to get on a plane, wants to take their unvaccinated children on that plane, maybe even say
sentences.zh: 一位已接种疫苗的成年人想重新开始旅行，想坐飞机，想带着未接种疫苗的孩子乘坐那架飞机，甚至可能说

sentences.en: travel internationally, wants global travel restrictions ease, and of course they will be allowed, we think, to do that.
sentences.zh: 想要进行国际旅行，想要全球旅行限制放宽，当然我们认为他们会被允许这样做。

sentences.en: But should they think about not doing that?
sentences.zh: 但他们是否应该考虑不要这样做？

sentences.en: Is it unwise?
sentences.zh: 这样做不明智吗？

sentences.en: I don't know if they'll be allowed to do that, to be honeSt. I think the adults will be.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不知道他们是否会被允许这样做。我认为成年人可以。

sentences.en: I'm not sure that the kids will be until they're vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我不确定孩子们在接种疫苗之前是否会被允许。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Do you imagine that rules may soon be in place that will only allow for vaccinated people to fly?
sentences.zh: 你认为是否很快就会出台规定，只允许接种过疫苗的人飞行？

sentences.en: I think that's highly likely.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很有可能。

sentences.en: We already have rules forbidding people from coming into the country unless they can show that they have a negative teSt. We don't even accept vaccination as proof.
sentences.zh: 我们已经有了禁止人们入境的规定，除非他们能出示阴性检测证明。我们甚至不接受疫苗接种作为证明。

sentences.en: We want them to show that they actually are free of the virus.
sentences.zh: 我们希望他们证明自己确实没有感染病毒。

sentences.en: And that's because of that little loophole where even if you're vaccinated, you can still transmit.
sentences.zh: 这是因为存在一个小漏洞，即使你接种了疫苗，仍然可能传播病毒。

sentences.en: So I don't even think even if it's allowed that it's a good idea for parents to take their kids to, I don't know, Morocco.
sentences.zh: 所以我甚至认为，即使是被允许的，父母带孩子去，比如说，摩洛哥，也不是一个好主意。

sentences.en: I say that because I was supposed to go there last year.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是因为我去年本该去那里的。

sentences.en: But yeah, it's not.
sentences.zh: 但确实，这不行。

sentences.en: Morocco could be crawling with all kinds of variants of the virus that my kids are not immune to, and maybe I'm not even immune to.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥可能充斥着各种我孩子没有免疫力，甚至连我可能都没有免疫力的病毒变种。

sentences.en: So the real danger is not just that, for example, kids might transmit the virus on the plane or catch the virus on the plane.
sentences.zh: 所以真正的危险不仅在于，例如，孩子们可能在飞机上传播病毒或在飞机上感染病毒。

sentences.en: It's that anyone on that trip, including a vaccinated adult, might contract a variant of the virus, bring it back to the U.S., and cause even more trouble.
sentences.zh: 而在于旅途中的任何人，包括已接种疫苗的成年人，都可能感染某种病毒变种，将其带回美国，并造成更大的麻烦。

sentences.en: Especially true of kids, but yes, it could happen to anybody.
sentences.zh: 这对孩子来说尤其如此，但确实，这种情况可能发生在任何人身上。

sentences.en: Okay, a final scenario.
sentences.zh: 好的，最后一个场景。

sentences.en: Grandparents, quite likely to be vaccinated in the next few months, very likely to want to see their unvaccinated grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 祖父母很可能在未来几个月内接种疫苗，他们非常想见未接种疫苗的孙辈。

sentences.en: And I suspect the inclination will be, I'm vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我猜他们的倾向会是：我已经接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: What's the worst thing that happens?
sentences.zh: 最坏的情况会怎样呢？

sentences.en: You know, I might carry the virus, but I'm not going to get very sick from it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可能会携带病毒，但我不会因此病得很重。

sentences.en: Is that the right calculation?
sentences.zh: 这种算盘打得对吗？

sentences.en: I don't know if it's the right calculation, but it'll be the one that most people make.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这算盘打得对不对，但这会是大多数人会做的选择。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people will hug their grandkids without masks on.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人会不戴口罩拥抱他们的孙辈。

sentences.en: But I would say ideally, maybe hug them and then put the mask on right away.
sentences.zh: 但我会说，理想情况下，也许拥抱完之后马上戴上口罩。

sentences.en: Because there'll still be a risk that someone who's older, who's vaccinated, might get infected.
sentences.zh: 因为对于那些年长且已接种疫苗的人来说，仍然存在被感染的风险。

sentences.en: And yes, these vaccines are amazing at protecting people.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些疫苗在保护人们方面非常出色。

sentences.en: But if that older person has some other health conditions or is particularly weak in some way, it's better not to take the risk of even giving them the virus at all.
sentences.zh: 但如果那位长者还有其他健康问题，或者在某些方面特别虚弱，最好还是不要冒任何把病毒传染给他们的风险。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And 90%, which I believe is the most effective version of these vaccines so far, is not 100%.
sentences.zh: 而且90%的有效率——我认为这是目前这些疫苗中最有效的版本——并不是100%。

sentences.en: It means that one out of every 10 people could still get sick.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每10个人中仍有1个人可能会生病。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so there are no guarantees.
sentences.zh: 所以没有任何保证。

sentences.en: Having said that, I fully understand why so many people will actually hug others and be close to others without wearing masks, because I know everyone misses that.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我完全理解为什么这么多人真的会拥抱他人，并在不戴口罩的情况下与他人亲近，因为我知道每个人都怀念那种感觉。

sentences.en: I know I miss that.
sentences.zh: 我知道我很怀念。

sentences.en: But I think as much as possible, if we can put those masks back on as soon as soon as we can, after getting that personal touch, that would be the safeSt.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，如果可能的话，在那种亲密接触后，我们能尽快戴回口罩，那将是最安全的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We are having this conversation with you at a moment of general optimism about the course
sentences.zh: 我们现在与你进行的这次谈话，正值人们对疫情的发展普遍感到乐观的时刻，

sentences.en: of the pandemic, because infection rates have been plunging over the past few weeks from a high,
sentences.zh: 因为过去几周感染率从高点大幅下降，

sentences.en: I just looked it up, of 300,000 a day on January 8th to under 65,000 a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 我刚查了一下，从1月8日每天30万例下降到几天前的不到6.5万例。

sentences.en: I know that number may fluctuate.
sentences.zh: 我知道这个数字可能会波动。

sentences.en: So it feels like the pandemic is at the moment starting to feel more under control despite the variants that have entered the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管有变种病毒进入美国，但疫情目前似乎开始感觉更受控制了。

sentences.en: And so how much of a factor is that as you think about the risks involved and having children be unvaccinated?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你考虑所涉及的风险以及儿童未接种疫苗的情况时，这在多大程度上是一个因素？

sentences.en: I don't want to puncture anyone's optimism here.
sentences.zh: 我不想在这里打破任何人的乐观情绪。

sentences.en: I think it is great that these numbers are falling.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些数字正在下降是一件好事。

sentences.en: But the best explanation we have for why these numbers are falling, not just in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 但对于为什么这些数字正在下降，不仅是在美国，

sentences.en: but all over the world, is that over the winter, when the cases were horribly high everywhere,
sentences.zh: 而是在全世界，我们能给出的最好解释是，在冬季，当各地病例极其严重时，

sentences.en: governments and individuals started to put precautions back into place.
sentences.zh: 政府和个人开始重新采取预防措施。

sentences.en: So if the numbers are falling now, it's because we've done all the right things.
sentences.zh: 所以如果现在的数字在下降，那是因为我们做了所有正确的事情。

sentences.en: And the worst thing we can do is celebrate too soon and stop doing them, because the numbers will come back up if that's the case.
sentences.zh: 而我们能做的最糟糕的事情就是过早庆祝并停止这些措施，因为如果是那样的话，数字还会回升。

sentences.en: You mentioned variants, and that's a very big wild card here.
sentences.zh: 你提到了变种，这是这里一个非常大的不确定因素。

sentences.en: We saw in the U.K.
sentences.zh: 我们在英国看到，

sentences.en: that B.1.1.7, this variant that was circulating there, went from almost nothing in September to being everywhere in the country by December.
sentences.zh: B.1.1.7这种在那里传播的变种，从9月份的几乎为零，到了12月份就遍布全国。

sentences.en: And scientists are predicting the same thing will happen here.
sentences.zh: 科学家们预测同样的情况也会在这里发生。

sentences.en: By mid-March or late March,
sentences.zh: 到3月中旬或下旬，

sentences.en: B.1.1.7 will be the dominant form of the virus in the United States.
sentences.zh: B.1.1.7将成为美国境内主要的病毒形式。

sentences.en: So depending on how that goes, depending on how careful we are, depending on how conservative
sentences.zh: 所以，取决于情况如何发展，取决于我们有多谨慎，取决于政治领导人在解除限制方面有多保守，

sentences.en: political leaders are in lifting restrictions, we could and we probably will see an increase in cases again.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会，而且很可能会再次看到病例增加。

sentences.en: And the other thing that we should remember is a lot of the most susceptible people in the population will be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我们还应该记住的另一件事是，人口中许多最易感的人群将会接种疫苗。

sentences.en: So we may see a big rise in cases, but not necessarily a big rise in hospitalizations or deaths.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可能会看到病例大幅上升，但不一定会看到住院或死亡人数大幅上升。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You're describing potentially a new wave.
sentences.zh: 你描述的是潜在的第四波疫情。

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: And this prospect of a fourth wave would seem to bring even more urgency to the mission of vaccinating everyone in the United States, not just adults, but children.
sentences.zh: 而这种第四波疫情的前景似乎让为美国每个人接种疫苗的任务变得更加紧迫，不仅是成年人，还有儿童。

sentences.en: Because as you said, herd immunity is ultimately the only real answer.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你所说，群体免疫最终是唯一的真正答案。

sentences.en: Well, we are not going to be vaccinating kids by the spring, which is really when we'll see this wave.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们不会在春季为孩子们接种疫苗，而那正是我们将看到这一波疫情的时候。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So we can't prevent it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们无法阻止它。

sentences.en: And we won't have enough vaccinations even in adults to really stop it probably.
sentences.zh: 而且即使在成年人中，我们可能也没有足够的疫苗来真正阻止它。

sentences.en: But what we can do is really minimize it.
sentences.zh: 但我们能做的是真正将其最小化。

sentences.en: We are not powerless here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里并非无能为力。

sentences.en: We have a lot of agency.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多主动权。

sentences.en: There are a lot of things we can do that we know to do.
sentences.zh: 有很多我们知道该做的事情可以做。

sentences.en: Wash our hands, wear masks, social distancing.
sentences.zh: 勤洗手、戴口罩、保持社交距离。

sentences.en: We know exactly what works.
sentences.zh: 我们确切地知道什么有效。

sentences.en: We've been talking about how this is going to be probably over by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在谈论这可能在年底前结束。

sentences.en: So it's just a matter of holding on for just a while longer.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是再坚持一会儿的问题。

sentences.en: Thank you, Apoorva.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Apoorva。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: It's been a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the federal government released new data showing that because of the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 周四，联邦政府发布了新数据，显示由于疫情，

sentences.en: life expectancy in the United States has fallen by a full year, the largest drop since World War II.
sentences.zh: 美国的预期寿命下降了整整一年，这是自二战以来的最大降幅。

sentences.en: In the first six months of 2020, the expected lifespan of an American fell from 78.8 years to 77.8 years.
sentences.zh: 在2020年的前六个月，美国人的预期寿命从78.8岁下降到了77.8岁。

sentences.en: In a sign of the disproportionate impact of the virus on people of color, the data
sentences.zh: 作为病毒对有色人种造成不成比例影响的一个迹象，数据显示，

sentences.en: showed that the decline in life expectancy was even deeper among Black Americans, falling 2.7 years.
sentences.zh: 非裔美国人的预期寿命下降幅度甚至更大，下降了2.7岁。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: We're here today because last November, 80 million Americans voted against Donald Trump and against everything he stood for.
sentences.zh: 我们今天在这里是因为去年11月，8000万美国人投票反对唐纳德·特朗普，反对他所代表的一切。

sentences.en: On Thursday, congressional allies of President Biden introduced his plan to overhaul the immigration system.
sentences.zh: 周四，拜登总统的国会盟友提出了他的移民系统改革计划。

sentences.en: The centerpiece of the legislation is an eight-year path to citizenship for most of the 11 million
sentences.zh: 该立法的核心是为截至1月1日居住在美国的1100万无证移民中的大多数人提供一条为期八年的入籍途径。

sentences.en: undocumented immigrants living in the United States as of January 1St. If adopted, the measure
sentences.zh: 如果获得通过，该措施

sentences.en: would represent the most far-reaching changes in immigration law in more than 30 years.
sentences.zh: 将代表30多年来移民法中最深远的变革。

sentences.en: And?
sentences.zh: 还有呢？

sentences.en: Perseverance is going about one kilometer per second at an altitude of about 16 kilometers from the surface of Mars.
sentences.zh: “毅力号”正以每秒约一公里的速度，在距离火星表面约16公里的高度飞行。

sentences.en: We have entered heading alignment.
sentences.zh: 我们已经进入航向对齐阶段。

sentences.en: NASA has landed a new robotic rover on Mars, its most ambitious effort in decades to directly study whether there was ever life on the Red Planet.
sentences.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）已将一辆新的机器人火星车降落在火星上，这是其几十年来最雄心勃勃的尝试，旨在直接研究火星上是否曾经存在过生命。

sentences.en: Touchdown confirmed.
sentences.zh: 确认着陆。

sentences.en: Perseverance, safe off life.
sentences.zh: “毅力号”，安全着陆。

sentences.en: The rover, named Perseverance, will explore a crater that was once filled with water.
sentences.zh: 这辆名为“毅力号”的火星车将探索一个曾经充满水的陨石坑。

sentences.en: NASA scientists believe that the piles of sediments there could contain remnants of ancient Martian microbes.
sentences.zh: NASA的科学家们认为，那里的沉积物堆可能包含古代火星微生物的残骸。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Alexandra Lee Young, with help from Austin Mitchell.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Alexandra Lee Young制作，Austin Mitchell提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 节目由M.J.

sentences.en: Davis-Lynn, Paige Cowett, and Lisa Chow, and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: Davis-Lynn、Paige Cowett和Lisa Chow编辑，Chris Wood负责工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是Michael Barbaro。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人们感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会因为断电而睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一件非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有任何过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台收听《The Wirecutter Show》。
